reviewers.summary: The deployment adds the requested environment variable. The plan test can pass when a duplicate variable violates the exactly-one requirement.

findingList.message: The assertion does not detect duplicate Demo__SeedCases entries with a value other than true. Count entries by name, then assert there is exactly one and its value is true.

evidence.codePathTraced: The assertion filters env entries by both name and value, then checks the matching count.
evidence.failureScenario: If the container has two Demo__SeedCases entries, one set to true and one set to false, the filter counts only the true entry and the assertion passes, despite the acceptance criterion requiring exactly one variable.

reviewers.summary: The Terraform change adds the requested environment variable. The new assertion misses a duplicate-variable state that violates the exact-one requirement.

findingList.message: The test does not catch duplicate Demo__SeedCases entries with a wrong value. Count all entries named Demo__SeedCases and assert there is exactly one, then assert that entry's value is true.

evidence.codePathTraced: The run block filters env entries by both name and value, then asserts that the filtered count is one.
evidence.failureScenario: If the app has one Demo__SeedCases=true entry and a second Demo__SeedCases=false entry, the filtered count remains one and the test passes, although the acceptance criterion requires exactly one variable.

reviewers.summary: The Terraform change adds the requested environment variable. The new test can pass with a duplicate variable, so it does not prove the exact-one acceptance criterion.

findingList.message: The test does not verify that Demo__SeedCases is unique. Count all entries with that name and assert there is exactly one and its value is true.

evidence.codePathTraced: The new plan assertion counts only entries whose name is Demo__SeedCases and whose value is true; it does not count all entries with that name.
evidence.failureScenario: If the container has both Demo__SeedCases=true and Demo__SeedCases=false, the assertion still counts one and passes, although the acceptance criterion requires exactly one variable.
